sec.title: August 25 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 103)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on **August 25** across American network, Duke Ellington's legendary live concert at the Hollywood Bowl broadcast worldwide via Voice of America, LAPD Chief James E. Davis narrating real police case files on *Calling All Cars* for Rio Grande Gasoline, two stagings of Sir Arthur Wing Pinero's Cumberland drama on *Author's Playhouse*, tropical marimbas, and Australian hardboiled crime (1939–1966):
